err_quiet_span: Start and end can't be the same
read_only: config.json could not be read, so settings are read-only. Fix or delete the file and restart.
err_hostname: Use a domain name like www.google.com
err_webhook: Only Discord or Slack webhook addresses are supported
err_logdir: Must be a folder inside the app folder
err_rate_limited: Too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
err_webhook_failed: The webhook didn't accept the message. Check the address and try again.
err_unavailable: This isn't available in this build.
gate_unauth_title: Open the dashboard from the app
gate_unauth_body: For your safety the dashboard only opens through Internet Monitor. Click the tray icon (or the app window) and choose “Open dashboard”.
gate_busy_body: Close a few other dashboard tabs, then retry.
gate_offline_body: The app may have closed. Start it again and this page will reconnect.
